title: Si Wu Kuai Du — Book 1
description: Classic primer for ages 4–5. 86 characters, 10 lessons.
source: Content transcribed from 四五快读 第一册 by 杨其铎 (Yang Qiduo). XieXie Go is not affiliated with the publisher. If this method works for your family, buy the full 8-volume set — the physical books include illustrations and the pedagogical scaffolding that makes SWKD effective.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hǎo bàba, hǎo māma.
sentences.english: I have a good dad and a good mom.

sentences.pinyin: Tiānshàng yǒu tàiyáng, yuèliàng, xīngxīng.
sentences.english: In the sky there is the sun, the moon, and stars.

sentences.pinyin: Dìshàng yǒu tǔ, shí, shān, shuǐtián.
sentences.english: On the ground there is soil, stones, mountains, and rice paddies.

sentences.pinyin: Bàba shàng shān, māma xià shān.
sentences.english: Dad goes up the mountain, mom comes down the mountain.

sentences.pinyin: Dìshàng yǒu xiǎoyáng hé dàshù.
sentences.english: On the ground there is a lamb and a big tree.

sentences.chinese: 草地上有水牛和小山羊。
sentences.pinyin: Cǎodì shàng yǒu shuǐniú hé xiǎo shānyáng.
sentences.english: On the grass there is a water buffalo and a little goat.

sentences.pinyin: Bàba hé māma xīn zhōng yǒu wǒ.
sentences.english: Dad and mom have me in their hearts.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīn zhōng yǒu bàba hé māma.
sentences.english: I have dad and mom in my heart.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu xiǎo shǒu.
sentences.english: I have little hands.

sentences.pinyin: Tóu shàng yǒu méi, mù, ěr, bí hé kǒu.
sentences.english: On the head there are eyebrows, eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.

sentences.pinyin: Méi xià yǒu mù, bí xià yǒu kǒu.
sentences.english: Below the eyebrows are the eyes, below the nose is the mouth.

sentences.pinyin: Shù shàng yǒu huā hé yè.
sentences.english: On the tree there are flowers and leaves.

sentences.chinese: 天上有明亮的太阳和月亮。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānshàng yǒu míngliàng de tàiyáng hé yuèliàng.
sentences.english: In the sky there is the bright sun and moon.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu bàba hé māma.
sentences.english: I have a dad and a mom.

sentences.pinyin: Míngrì yǒu dàfēng, xià dàyǔ.
sentences.english: Tomorrow there will be strong wind and heavy rain.

sentences.pinyin: Shítou shàng yǒu xiǎocǎo hé xiǎohuā.
sentences.english: On the stone there is little grass and little flowers.

sentences.chinese: 我是爸爸、妈妈的好孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shì bàba, māma de hǎo háizi.
sentences.english: I am dad and mom's good child.

sentences.chinese: 天是太阳、月亮、星星的家。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān shì tàiyáng, yuèliàng, xīngxīng de jiā.
sentences.english: The sky is the home of the sun, moon, and stars.
In the daytime, the red sun is in the sky;

sentences.chinese: 地上有红花、白花和小草。
sentences.english: on the ground there are red flowers, white flowers, and little grass.

sentences.pinyin: Niú hé xiǎo shānyáng.
sentences.english: A cow and a little goat.

sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān duōyún, yǒu xiǎoyǔ.
sentences.english: Tomorrow will be cloudy with light rain.

sentences.chinese: 我家有爷爷、奶奶、爸爸、妈妈和我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒjiā yǒu yéye, nǎinai, bàba, māma hé wǒ.
sentences.english: My family has grandpa, grandma, dad, mom, and me.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷爱我，奶奶爱我，爸爸爱我，妈妈爱我。
sentences.english: Grandpa loves me, grandma loves me, dad loves me, mom loves me.

sentences.chinese: 我爱爷爷、奶奶、爸爸、妈妈。
sentences.english: I love grandpa, grandma, dad, and mom.

sentences.chinese: 我是宝宝，我在家爱唱儿歌。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shì bǎobao, wǒ zàijiā ài chàng érgē.
sentences.english: I'm a baby, at home I love to sing nursery rhymes.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bú ài kū, wǒ ài xiào.
sentences.english: I don't like to cry, I like to laugh.

sentences.chinese: 小头爸爸和大头儿子玩游戏。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎotóu bàba hé Dàtóu érzi wán yóuxì.
sentences.english: Small-Head Dad and Big-Head Son play games. (famous Chinese cartoon)

sentences.chinese: 小宝宝是爱学习的好孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo bǎobao shì ài xuéxí de hǎo háizi.
sentences.english: The little baby is a good child who loves to learn.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷爱看书，奶奶爱看戏，爸爸爱看书，妈妈爱唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye ài kàn shū, nǎinai ài kàn xì, bàba ài kàn shū, māma ài chàng gē.
sentences.english: Grandpa loves reading books, grandma loves watching plays, dad loves reading books, mom loves singing.

sentences.chinese: 我爱爷爷、奶奶、爸爸和妈妈。
sentences.english: I love grandpa, grandma, dad, and mom.
I am everyone's good treasure.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ài kàn shū, wǒ ài xuéxí.
sentences.english: I love reading books, I love studying.

sentences.chinese: 天上有太阳、月亮、星星和白云；
sentences.english: In the sky there is the sun, moon, stars, and white clouds;

sentences.chinese: 地上有土、石、山、水、花和树木。
sentences.english: on the ground there is soil, stones, mountains, water, flowers, and trees.

sentences.chinese: 不爱生气、不爱哭的孩子爱笑，我是好孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Bú ài shēngqì, bú ài kū de háizi ài xiào, wǒ shì hǎo háizi.
sentences.english: A child who doesn't get angry and doesn't cry loves to laugh — I am a good child.
Dad's dad is grandpa.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷的儿子是爸爸，我是爸爸的儿子。
sentences.english: Grandpa's son is dad, I am dad's son.

notes: Each lesson follows the authentic SWKD structure: new characters (生字), then compound words (词语) that use those characters plus earlier ones, then full sentences (句子) for reading practice. The lessons array preserves the full structure for rendering. The words array flattens to individual characters for Box/SRS state tracking. Compound discovery will fire heavily — roughly every word in every lesson is a buildable combination of characters the kid already knows. When Phase 2 Claude Code renders this pack, it should show the lesson structure (not just a flat character list) and let parents choose: practice new characters only, practice words for this lesson, or practice reading the sentences aloud.
